title_sq: SHITET APARTAMENT 2+1+2 NE RRUGEN E ELBASANIT
description_sq:
Apartament 2+1 per shitje ne kompleksin rezidencial me te ri qe po ndertohet nga kompania Xheluks Construction ne rrugen Viena prane Restorant Xibraku.
Prona pozicionohet ne katin e katert me nje siperfaqe totale 123m2 dhe organizohet ne ambient ndenje, ambient gatimi, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe ballkon.
Orientohet totalisht nga lindja me nje pamje fantastike te natyres se parkut.
Zona eshte shume e qete, e sigurt dhe me komunitet shume te mire pasi prane ndodhen selite e disa ambasadave.
Per me shume informacione na kontaktoni.

title_en: APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2 IN ELBASANI STREET
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the newest residential complex being built by Xheluks Construction on Viena street near Xibraku Restaurant. The property is located on the fourth floor with a total area of ​​123m2 and is organized into a living room, kitchen, two bedrooms, two bathrooms and a balcony. It is totally oriented to the east with a fantastic view of the nature of the park. The area is very quiet, safe and with a very good community as the headquarters of several embassies are located nearby. For more information, contact us. SUN120012
